description: This file contains the implementation of the Order Data Access Object (DAO) for the OpenMRS platform, specifically the HibernateOrderDAO class. It includes methods for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting Orders and related entities, utilizing Hibernate ORM with criteria queries and direct SQL where necessary.

classes.name: HibernateOrderDAO
classes.description: Implements the OrderDAO interface using Hibernate ORM to manage Order-related database operations within the OpenMRS platform.

methods.name: saveOrder
methods.description: Persists an Order object into the database, performing either insert or update.

methods.name: deleteOrder
methods.description: Removes a specified Order from the database.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Retrieves an Order by its primary key (orderId).

methods.name: getOrders
methods.description: Fetches a list of Orders filtered by various parameters including type, patients, concepts, orderers, and encounters.

methods.name: getOrders (OrderSearchCriteria)
methods.description: Fetches Orders matching complex criteria encapsulated in OrderSearchCriteria, such as date ranges, statuses, and attributes.

methods.name: getOrderByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a unique Order entity based on its UUID.

methods.name: getDiscontinuationOrder
methods.description: Finds the discontinuation order linked to a given order.

methods.name: getRevisionOrder
methods.description: Finds the revision order linked to a given order.

methods.name: getOrderFromDatabase
methods.description: Executes a direct SQL query to fetch order details; can include drug order specifics.

methods.name: saveOrderGroup
methods.description: Persists an OrderGroup entity into the database.

methods.name: getOrderGroupByUuid
methods.description: Fetches an OrderGroup based on its UUID.

methods.name: getOrderGroupById
methods.description: Fetches an OrderGroup by its primary key.

methods.name: deleteObsThatReference
methods.description: Deletes Obs records referencing a particular Order.

methods.name: getOrderByOrderNumber
methods.description: Retrieves an Order using its unique order number.

methods.name: getNextOrderNumberSeedSequenceValue
methods.description: Gets and increments the sequence seed value for generating new order numbers.

methods.name: getActiveOrders
methods.description: Returns current active orders for a patient and optionally other filters.

methods.name: getCareSetting
methods.description: Fetches a CareSetting by its ID.

methods.name: getCareSettingByUuid
methods.description: Fetches a CareSetting entity by UUID.

methods.name: getCareSettingByName
methods.description: Returns a CareSetting matching the specified name.

methods.name: getCareSettings
methods.description: Retrieves list of CareSettings, optionally including retired ones.

methods.name: getOrderTypeByName
methods.description: Fetches an OrderType by its name.

methods.name: getOrderFrequency
methods.description: Retrieves an OrderFrequency by its ID.

methods.name: getOrderFrequencyByUuid
methods.description: Fetches an OrderFrequency entity based on UUID.

methods.name: getOrderFrequencies
methods.description: Retrieves list of order frequencies, optionally filtering by status.

methods.name: getOrderFrequencies (with filters)
methods.description: Retrieves OrderFrequencies based on search phrase, locale, and other filters.

methods.name: saveOrderFrequency
methods.description: Persists an OrderFrequency object.

methods.name: purgeOrderFrequency
methods.description: Deletes an OrderFrequency from the database.

methods.name: isOrderFrequencyInUse
methods.description: Checks if an OrderFrequency is referenced by any Order entities.

methods.name: getOrderFrequencyByConcept
methods.description: Finds OrderFrequency associated with a specific Concept.

methods.name: getOrderType
methods.description: Retrieve an OrderType by ID.

methods.name: getOrderTypeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieve an OrderType by its UUID.

methods.name: getOrderTypes
methods.description: List all OrderTypes, with option to include retired.

methods.name: getOrderTypeByConceptClass
methods.description: Finds OrderType associated with a given ConceptClass.

methods.name: saveOrderType
methods.description: Persist an OrderType.

methods.name: purgeOrderType
methods.description: Deletes an OrderType.

methods.name: getSubtypes
methods.description: Returns subtypes of a given OrderType, optionally including retired.

methods.name: isOrderTypeInUse
methods.description: Checks whether any Order uses the specified OrderType.

methods.name: getOrderGroupsByPatient
methods.description: Fetch all OrderGroups for a patient.

methods.name: getOrderGroupsByEncounter
methods.description: Fetch OrderGroups associated with a specific encounter.

methods.name: getAllOrderGroupAttributeTypes
methods.description: Retrieve all OrderGroupAttributeType entries.

methods.name: getOrderGroupAttributeType
methods.description: Fetch OrderGroupAttributeType by ID.

methods.name: getOrderGroupAttributeTypeByUuid
methods.description: Fetch OrderGroupAttributeType by UUID.

methods.name: saveOrderGroupAttributeType
methods.description: Save or update an OrderGroupAttributeType entity.

methods.name: deleteOrderGroupAttributeType
methods.description: Remove an OrderGroupAttributeType.

methods.name: getOrderGroupAttributeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieve an OrderGroupAttribute by UUID.

methods.name: getOrderGroupAttributeTypeByName
methods.description: Find OrderGroupAttributeType by name.

methods.name: getOrderAttributeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieve an OrderAttribute by UUID.

methods.name: getAllOrderAttributeTypes
methods.description: Retrieve all OrderAttributeType records.

methods.name: getOrderAttributeTypeById
methods.description: Retrieve OrderAttributeType by ID.

methods.name: getOrderAttributeTypeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieve OrderAttributeType by UUID.

methods.name: saveOrderAttributeType
methods.description: Save or update an OrderAttributeType.

methods.name: deleteOrderAttributeType
methods.description: Deletes an OrderAttributeType.

methods.name: getOrderAttributeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieve an OrderAttribute by UUID.

methods.name: getOrderAttributeTypeByName
methods.description: Fetch OrderAttributeType by name.
